scope: Aspergillus five-variable csi landscape: r/s=0.89 in Section 4/Figure 4; same source-pinned 32 rows already reviewed for gamma. This does not certify gamma-star or TEM targets.
preprocessing: Retain every input row with equal weight; no missing-state imputation, subsampling, uncertainty adjustment or RNG. Fit intercept plus 0/1 predictors by OLS; r is residual RMSE (divide by N); s is mean absolute non-intercept coefficient. Graph edges and optimization direction do not affect the statistic. Natural log of positive W, no rounding or other transformation.
